row:
At Moraine Park Technical College, our mission is more than words; it is a promise to inspire, educate and uplift our communities. With locations in Beaver Dam, Fond du Lac, Horicon and West Bend, Moraine Park serves more than 15,000 students from many walks of life each year.

With a legacy of more than 100 years, Moraine Park proves that Tech is Timeless.
